goal: Look up the CMDB inventory record for host soc-playground to determine its role, zone, criticality, owner, and trust edges.
what_to_summarize: host role (e.g. web-server, bastion, container-host, etc.)
zone (internal, dmz, etc.)
criticality level (sandbox, dev, preprod, prod)
owner field
trust_edges_out declarations
any per-host users: overrides
whether this host appears in the inventory at all

goal: Retrieve the 6 Falco "Sudo execution" events on soc-playground between 06:41-06:55Z on 2026-07-28 to identify the user, process, command, and container context driving the sudo burst.
what_to_summarize: falco.output_fields.user.name for each sudo event
falco.output_fields.proc.name and proc.cmdline for each event
falco.output_fields.container.name and container.id for each event
falco.output_fields.proc.pname (parent process) for each event
falco.output_fields.proc.loginuid and proc.tty if present
timestamp of each sudo event
any falco.output_fields.user.uid values

params.query:
FROM logs-falco.alerts-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-28T06:41:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T06:56:00Z"
        AND host.name == "soc-playground"
        AND falco.rule == "Sudo execution"
| KEEP @timestamp,
       falco.output_fields.user.name,
       falco.output_fields.user.uid,
       falco.output_fields.proc.name,
       falco.output_fields.proc.cmdline,
       falco.output_fields.proc.pname,
       falco.output_fields.proc.loginuid,
       falco.output_fields.proc.tty,
       falco.output_fields.container.id
| SORT @timestamp ASC

FROM logs-falco.alerts-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-28T06:41:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T06:56:00Z"
        AND host.name == "soc-playground"
        AND falco.rule == "Sudo execution"
| KEEP @timestamp,
       falco.output_fields.user.name,
       falco.output_fields.user.uid,
       falco.output_fields.proc.name,
       falco.output_fields.proc.cmdline,
       falco.output_fields.proc.pname,
       falco.output_fields.proc.tty,
       falco.output_fields.container.id
| SORT @timestamp ASC

goal: Search for co-occurring Falco rule events on soc-playground between 06:30Z and 07:00Z on 2026-07-28 beyond the Sudo execution rule, covering adjacent attack phases like cron writes, sensitive file reads, tmp writes, or authorized_keys modification.
what_to_summarize: all distinct falco.rule values firing on soc-playground in the window
any write-below-etc or cron-related Falco rules
any read-sensitive-file or similar Falco rules
any authorized-keys-modification Falco rules
any Launch Suspicious Network Tool Falco rules
count and timestamps of each co-occurring rule
container.name for any co-occurring events

params.query:
FROM logs-falco.alerts-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-28T06:30:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T07:00:00Z"
        AND host.name == "soc-playground"
        AND falco.rule != "Sudo execution"
| STATS events     = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY rule      = falco.rule,
           proc      = falco.output_fields.proc.name,
           parent    = falco.output_fields.proc.pname,
           container = falco.output_fields.container.id
| SORT events DESC

FROM logs-falco.alerts-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-28T06:30:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T07:00:00Z"
        AND host.name == "soc-playground"
        AND falco.rule != "Sudo execution"
        AND (falco.rule LIKE "*write*etc*" 
             OR falco.rule LIKE "*cron*" 
             OR falco.rule LIKE "*authorized*key*"
             OR falco.rule LIKE "*read*sensitive*"
             OR falco.rule LIKE "*Launch Suspicious Network*"
             OR falco.rule LIKE "*Drop and execute*"
             OR falco.rule LIKE "*Redirect STDOUT*"
             OR falco.rule LIKE "*Ingress Remote File*")
| STATS events     = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY rule      = falco.rule,
           proc      = falco.output_fields.proc.name,
           parent    = falco.output_fields.proc.pname,
           container = falco.output_fields.container.id
| SORT events DESC

FROM logs-falco.alerts-*

        AND host.name == "soc-playground"
        AND falco.rule != "Sudo execution"
        AND (falco.rule LIKE "*Write*"

| STATS events     = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY rule      = falco.rule,
           proc      = falco.output_fields.proc.name,
           parent    = falco.output_fields.proc.pname,
           container = falco.output_fields.container.id
| SORT events DESC

FROM logs-falco.alerts-*

goal: Search Keycloak event logs in logs-keycloak.events-* between 05:45Z and 06:55Z on 2026-07-28 for credential stuffing patterns: bursts of LOGIN_ERROR events followed by successful LOGIN events from the same IP address.
what_to_summarize: Keycloak LOGIN_ERROR events in the window — count, usernames, IP addresses, timestamps
Keycloak LOGIN events (successful) in the window — usernames, IP addresses, timestamps
whether any IP shows a pattern of multiple LOGIN_ERRORs followed by a successful LOGIN (stuffing signature)
any REFRESH_TOKEN or LOGOUT events in the window
the clientId for any login events
time gap between last failed login and first successful login for any stuffed account

params.query:
FROM logs-keycloak.events-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-28T05:45:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T06:55:00Z"
  AND loggerName == "org.keycloak.events"
| EVAL event_type = CASE(
    message LIKE "*type=\"LOGIN_ERROR\"*", "LOGIN_ERROR",
    message LIKE "*type=\"LOGIN\"*", "LOGIN",
    message LIKE "*type=\"LOGOUT\"*", "LOGOUT",
    message LIKE "*type=\"REFRESH_TOKEN\"*", "REFRESH_TOKEN",
    "OTHER"
  )
| STATS total = COUNT(*),
        login_errors = COUNT(*) WHERE event_type == "LOGIN_ERROR",
        logins = COUNT(*) WHERE event_type == "LOGIN",
        logouts = COUNT(*) WHERE event_type == "LOGOUT",
        refresh_tokens = COUNT(*) WHERE event_type == "REFRESH_TOKEN",
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
  BY event_type

FROM logs-keycloak.events-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-28T05:45:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T06:55:00Z"
  AND loggerName == "org.keycloak.events"
  AND message LIKE "*type=\"LOGIN_ERROR\"*"
| GROK message "%{DATA}ipAddress=\"%{IP:ip_address}\"%{DATA}"
| STATS count = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
  BY ip_address
| SORT count DESC

FROM logs-keycloak.events-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-28T05:45:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T06:55:00Z"
  AND loggerName == "org.keycloak.events"
  AND message LIKE "*type=\"LOGIN_ERROR\"*"
| GROK message "%{DATA}username=\"%{DATA:username}\"%{DATA}"
| GROK message "%{DATA}clientId=\"%{DATA:client_id}\"%{DATA}"
| STATS count = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
  BY username, client_id
| SORT count DESC

FROM logs-keycloak.events-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-28T05:45:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T06:55:00Z"
  AND loggerName == "org.keycloak.events"
  AND message LIKE "*type=\"LOGIN\"*"
| GROK message "%{DATA}ipAddress=\"%{IP:ip_address}\"%{DATA}"
| GROK message "%{DATA}username=\"%{DATA:username}\"%{DATA}"
| GROK message "%{DATA}clientId=\"%{DATA:client_id}\"%{DATA}"
| STATS count = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
  BY ip_address, username, client_id
| SORT count DESC

FROM logs-keycloak.events-*

  AND loggerName == "org.keycloak.events"
  AND message LIKE "*type=\"LOGIN\"*"
| GROK message "%{DATA}ipAddress=\"%{IP:ip_address}\"%{DATA}"

| GROK message "%{DATA}clientId=\"%{DATA:client_id}\"%{DATA}"
| STATS count = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
  BY ip_address, username, client_id
| SORT count DESC

FROM logs-keycloak.events-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-28T00:00:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-29T00:00:00Z"
  AND loggerName == "org.keycloak.events"
| EVAL event_type = CASE(
    message LIKE "*type=\"LOGIN_ERROR\"*", "LOGIN_ERROR",
    message LIKE "*type=\"LOGIN\"*", "LOGIN",
    message LIKE "*type=\"LOGOUT\"*", "LOGOUT",

  )
| STATS count = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),

  BY event_type
| SORT count DESC

FROM logs-keycloak.events-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-28T05:45:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T06:55:00Z"
  AND loggerName == "org.keycloak.events"
  AND message LIKE "*type=\"LOGIN_ERROR\"*"
| GROK message "%{DATA}ipAddress=\"%{IP:ip_address}\"%{DATA}"
| GROK message "%{DATA}username=\"%{DATA:username}\"%{DATA}"

| KEEP @timestamp, ip_address, username, client_id
| SORT @timestamp ASC
| LIMIT 1000

FROM logs-keycloak.events-*
